decision.rationale: The dispute is within the time limit. TXN-008082 posted on 2026-08-28 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-26, which is 59 days later. The limit is 120 days. TXN-008082 is on card CRD-000077 for 4777 EUR minor units at Kestrel Athletic Club (MER-000027). The charge was made on 2026-08-27 (transaction_at 2026-08-27T19:57:26Z). The merchant's cancellation confirmation DOC-000063 says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-08-28. The cancellation therefore took effect the day after the charge, so the charge belongs to a period the cardholder had not yet cancelled. Under recurring-cancelled-after-charge, the dispute is declined.
